question: Vish Kal's last ability gives a creature -1/-1 for each counter I remove. Do I gain life from Vish Kal's lifelink when that happens?

expected.shortAnswer: No: the ability does not deal damage, so lifelink gains you no life.
expected.answer: Vish Kal's last ability doesn't deal damage. It doesn't cause you to gain any life from its lifelink ability.
